title: Coldest countries (average yearly temperature)
prompt: Name the 10 sovereign countries with the coldest average temperature over the year

source.name: Wikipedia: List of countries by average yearly temperature

fact.text: It has the world's northernmost settlement, Canadian Forces Station Alert, on Ellesmere Island.
In Oymyakon, the coldest inhabited place on Earth, schools close only when it drops below −55 °C.
Its capital, Ulaanbaatar, is the coldest in the world and the coldest city of over a million people.
Okjökull was the first of its glaciers to melt away because of climate change.
Its record low is −51.4 °C, in Karasjok, yet some coastal lighthouses vary just 10 °C over the year.
Its record low is −51.5 °C, and without the Gulf Stream its winters would be much colder.
The Tian Shan mountains cover over 80% of it, so it's sometimes called the Switzerland of Central Asia.
The world's first ice hotel, at Jukkasjärvi, is rebuilt from snow and ice every winter.
The Pamir Highway, the world's second-highest international road, runs from its capital, Dushanbe, to Osh.
In 2005 it became the first country to hold binding internet voting nationwide, in its local elections.
